title: Product of absolutely summable real or complex families
statement:
Let $K=\mathbf R$ or $\mathbf C$ with usual absolute value [def-weil-complex-absolute-value], let $I,J$ be any sets, and let $u:I\to K$, $v:J\to K$. Suppose $\sum_i|u_i|$ and $\sum_j|v_j|$ are summable, where summability means convergence of finite subsums. Then the family $(u_i v_j)_{(i,j)\in I\times J}$ is absolutely summable, and
$$\sum_{(i,j)\in I\times J}u_i v_j=\left(\sum_i u_i\right)\left(\sum_j v_j\right).$$
Empty index sets are allowed.
